title: Self-Preservation
coreMove: Protect the conditions that keep the system viable before chasing expansion or approval.
sourcePressure: Self-Preservation concerns survival, integrity, protective behavior, and defending essential conditions under pressure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: treating self-preservation as selfishness or fear of change

hook: opening with a definition of Self-Preservation
counterintuition: treating self-preservation as selfishness or fear of change
tryThisNow: set a timer and think about it
audit your life with no chapter-specific object
examples: same dashboard meeting with swapped names
kitchen-table family argument unless the domain requires it
teacher and student scene used as default proof

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
